claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 21.1-megapixel sensor.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies the body as Canon EOS 5D Mark II, but provides no sensor/megapixel confirmation from photos.
Canon logo and EOS markings are visible on photo 0; Canon text appears on the body label in photo 2.

risks.risk: Lens not included (photos show only the camera body), which can make the unit unusable for shooting without buying a lens.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the full package contents laid out (camera + lens + caps/hood) or a video pan of what is included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only (no lens), assuming the buyer must source a lens separately.

risks.risk: Sensor condition unknown (dust/scratches/fungus) and shutter count/usage history unknown.
risks.proof: A close-up sensor test shot (white wall at f/16) plus a screen showing shutter count/actuation history (or a shutter count readout app screenshot).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially worn/dirty sensor and unknown shutter life (worst-case for resale).

risks.risk: LCD functionality and dead pixels unknown (no close-up test shown).
risks.proof: Video clip showing the LCD in live view with menus scrolling and a close-up of the screen for dead pixels/banding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as LCD may be faulty/needs replacement.

risks.risk: Battery health and whether battery/charger are included unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact battery model(s) and charger included, plus a short power-on video showing battery level and charging/usage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery/charger not included or battery health unknown (assume buyer must buy/replace).

risks.risk: All buttons/ports working unknown (USB/HDMI/AV) and memory card presence unknown.
risks.proof: Video showing ports being used (e.g., HDMI output to a monitor or USB connection to a laptop) and a photo of included memory card.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested functionality for ports and assume no memory card included.

risks.risk: Physical damage (dents, cracks, worn grips) not visible from the provided angles.
risks.proof: Full 360° walkaround video (front, back, sides, top, bottom) under bright light to reveal cracks/dents/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically imperfect/possible wear since damage cannot be ruled out.

proof_requests: Confirm whether a lens is included; send a photo/video of the full items in the box (lens + caps + body cap if any).
Send a sensor test image (white wall at high f-stop) and any shutter count/actuation screenshot.
Send a short video showing LCD live view and menu navigation, plus a close-up for dead pixels.
Show the exact battery and charger included (photos of labels/models) and a power-on video with battery level.
Show included memory card (if any) and demonstrate one port working (USB or HDMI) via video.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II camera body, so it can be priced at its worst case. However, key functionality/accessories (lens, sensor, shutter count, LCD, battery/charger, ports) are not proven by the photos, so pricing should assume body-only and unverified condition.
